name: ButtonGroup
summary: Related buttons side by side as one named group, such as a form's actions or a view's tools. A fundamental by the owner's definition, being that common; a product can still define its own group as a compound. Not for one exclusive choice that applies at once (use SegmentedControl), for a toolbar of mixed controls (use Toolbar) or for on/off settings (use Switch).
a11y: `role="group"` named by `label`; each Button keeps its own name, target and focus ring, and Tab moves through them in order. Attached members keep the size of their own step, so targets don't shrink when joined.

keys.action: moves to the next button in the group

props.name: label
props.description: The group's accessible name: what the buttons have in common, e.g. "Text alignment" or "Page actions".

props.name: children
props.description: The Buttons, in reading order: one primary at most.

props.name: arrangement
props.description: `spaced` (default): a pair's gap apart. `attached`: joined into one shape; only the group's outer ends are rounded and members share one line between them.
